title: Ample sets in Cartesian products
summary: Ample sets of hypercubes, introduced by A. Dress in 1995, constitute a combinatorial structure with rich properties and important examples. Ample sets can be characterized in a multitude of combinatorial, graph-theoretical, recursive, and geometrical ways, and they are equivalent to lopsided sets introduced by J. Lawrence in 1983. In this paper, we define and investigate ample sets of Cartesian products $U=U_1\times\cdots\times U_m$.
